settings.purpose: the model this agent runs, so that changing it is a setting and not a new version. It must read text and hold a whole package in one context. The package names no model of its own: absent, the model the host runs agents on (AGENT_MODEL) is used, and with neither the review goes without the model and says so. A name starting google-vertex-anthropic/ is Claude on Google Vertex AI, paid for with a token from the machine it runs on, and the credential is then where to call, written <project>/<location>; a bare name, or one starting google/, is a Gemini model reached at Google, and the credential is then its key; any other provider is refused in words

directories.name: records
directories.purpose: what was given, the house-rule check, the model's review, the check of its findings, the calls and the findings document, for each job
